articles.title_cn: 异质性噪声与稳定失调
articles.abstract_en: Coordination games feature two types of equilibria: pure equilibria, where players successfully coordinate their actions, and mixed equilibria, where players frequently experience miscoordination. We investigate learning dynamics where agents observe the actions of a random sample of their opponents. First, we show that when all agents have the same sample size, whether it is small or large, their behavior converges to one of the pure coordinated equilibria. By contrast, our main results show that stable miscoordination often persists when some agents make decisions based on small samples while others rely on large samples. (JEL C72, C73, C78)
articles.abstract_cn: 协调博弈具有两类均衡：纯策略均衡，其中参与者成功协调其行动；以及混合策略均衡，其中参与者频繁经历失调。我们研究了代理人观察其对手随机样本行动的学习动态。首先，我们表明，当所有代理人具有相同的样本量时，无论样本量大小，其行为都会收敛到某个纯协调均衡。相比之下，我们的主要结果表明，当一些代理人基于小样本做出决策而其他代理人依赖大样本时，稳定失调往往持续存在。（JEL C72, C73, C78）

articles.title_en: Optimal Trade Mechanisms with Adverse Selection and Inferential Naïvety
articles.title_cn: 逆向选择与推断天真下的最优交易机制
articles.abstract_en: We study an adverse selection environment in which a buyer's inferential ability is heterogeneous: A rational type correctly infers the value of the good from a seller's offer, whereas a naïve type is inattentive to the correlation between the seller's private information and the offer. We characterize the optimal menu mechanism that maximizes the seller's profits or trade surplus. Notably, no matter how severe the adverse selection is, all types of buyers trade. We then provide conditions under which the menu mechanism is optimal among all general mechanisms. A consumer protection policy limiting the naïve buyer's loss is also investigated. (JEL D18, D82, D86, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个逆向选择环境，其中买方的推断能力是异质的：理性类型能正确地从卖方的报价中推断商品的价值，而天真类型则对卖方私人信息与报价之间的相关性不关注。我们刻画了最大化卖方利润或交易盈余的最优菜单机制。值得注意的是，无论逆向选择多么严重，所有类型的买方都会进行交易。随后，我们提供了菜单机制在所有一般机制中为最优的条件。此外，还探讨了一项限制天真买方损失的消费者保护政策。（JEL D18, D82, D86, D91）

articles.abstract_en: Should platforms be liable for harms suffered by users? A platform enables interactions between firms and users. Harmful firms impose larger costs on users than safe firms. If firms have deep pockets and are fully liable for harms, platform liability is unnecessary. If firms have limited liability, holding platforms liable for residual harm increases platforms' incentives to raise interaction prices and invest in auditing to deter, detect, and block harmful firms. The social desirability and optimal level of platform liability depend on whether interactions require user consent, the degree to which users internalize harms, and the observability of platform effort. (JEL D21, K13, K22, L81, L82, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 平台是否应对用户遭受的损害负责？平台促进了企业与用户之间的互动。有害企业给用户带来的成本高于安全企业。如果企业资金雄厚且对损害承担全部责任，则平台责任并非必要。若企业承担有限责任，让平台对剩余损害负责，会增加平台提高互动价格并进行审计以威慑、发现和阻止有害企业的激励。平台责任的社会合意性和最优水平取决于互动是否需要用户同意、用户内化损害的程度以及平台努力的可观察性。（JEL D21, K13, K22, L81, L82, L86）

articles.abstract_en: We study a sequential experimentation model with endogenous feedback. Agents choose between a safe and risky action, the latter generating stochastic rewards. When making this choice, each agent is selfishly motivated (myopic). However, agents can disclose their experiences to a public record, and when doing so are prosocially motivated (forward-looking). Disclosure is both polarized (only extreme signals are disclosed) and positively biased (no feedback is bad news). The extent of disclosure is non-monotone in prior uncertainty. Subsidizing disclosure costs can paradoxically lead to less disclosure, but more experimentation. (JEL D81, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个具有内生反馈的序贯实验模型。代理人选择安全行动或风险行动，后者产生随机回报。在做此选择时，每个代理人是自私动机（短视）的。然而，代理人可以将他们的经验披露到公共记录中，并且在此过程中是亲社会动机（前瞻性）的。披露既呈现极化（只有极端信号被披露）又呈现正向偏差（没有反馈是坏消息）。披露程度在先验不确定性下是非单调的。补贴披露成本可能悖论性地导致更少的披露，但更多的实验。（JEL D81, D82, D83）

articles.abstract_en: A monopolistic seller possesses an inventory containing distinct products, each consumer wishes to buy a single product, and the seller can steer consumers' choices. We fully characterize the producer-consumer surplus pairs induced by market segmentation when the number of products is large. The same characterization holds if the seller cannot price discriminate. We also investigate the relationship between consumer surplus, social welfare, and consumer privacy. Along the Pareto frontier, points with greater consumer surplus can be reached by market segmentations that afford more privacy. (JEL D42, D83, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 一个垄断卖家拥有包含不同产品的库存，每个消费者希望购买单一产品，且卖家可以引导消费者的选择。当产品数量众多时，我们全面刻画了由市场细分所引致的生产者-消费者剩余组合。如果卖家不能进行价格歧视，同样的刻画依然成立。我们还研究了消费者剩余、社会福利与消费者隐私之间的关系。在帕累托前沿上，具有更高消费者剩余的点可以通过提供更多隐私的市场细分来实现。（JEL D42, D83, L81）

articles.title_en: Social Learning and Strategic Pricing with Rating Systems
articles.title_cn: 社会学习与评级体系下的战略定价
articles.abstract_en: Rating systems, widely used in online transactions, often reduce buyers' diverse opinions to summary statistics. To explore the consequences of this coarse aggregation, we analyze a dynamic adverse selection model where buyers share anonymous evaluations via a rating system. With heterogeneous buyers, the seller is tempted to secretly lower prices to attract favorable ratings from price-sensitive buyers. That leads to sporadic flash sales. The seller's incentive to manipulate ratings is, however, self-defeating. Our analysis illustrates how the rating system shapes the allocation of surplus and offers insights for platform and product design. (JEL D11, D82, L11, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 评级系统广泛应用于在线交易，往往将买家的多样化意见简化为汇总统计。为探讨这种粗略聚合的后果，我们分析了一个动态逆向选择模型，其中买家通过评级系统分享匿名评价。在买家异质的情况下，卖家有动机秘密降价以吸引对价格敏感的买家给出好评，这导致了零星的限时抢购。然而，卖家操纵评级的动机是弄巧成拙的。我们的分析阐明了评级系统如何影响剩余分配，并为平台和产品设计提供了见解。(JEL D11, D82, L11, L81)

articles.title_en: Optimal Voting Mechanisms on Generalized Single-Peaked Domains
articles.title_cn: 广义单峰域上的最优投票机制
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the design of voting mechanisms. There are multiple alternatives, and the voters have generalized single-peaked preferences derived from median spaces as introduced in Nehring and Puppe (2007b). This class of preferences covers a wide range of economically relevant domains, and it is much larger than the well-known single-peaked preferences on a line. I characterize the welfare-maximizing voting rules among all social choice functions satisfying strategy-proofness, anonymity, and surjectivity. The optimal mechanisms are composed of binary votes on subsets of alternatives involving flexible majority requirements. (JEL D71, D72, D82)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究投票机制的设计问题。存在多个备选方案，选民具有源自中位数空间的广义单峰偏好，如Nehring和Puppe（2007b）所引入。这类偏好覆盖了广泛的经济相关领域，且远大于众所周知的直线上的单峰偏好。我在所有满足策略证明性、匿名性和满射性的社会选择函数中，刻画了福利最大化的投票规则。最优机制由对备选方案子集进行的二元投票组成，并涉及灵活多数要求。（JEL D71, D72, D82）

articles.title_en: Simple Manipulations in School Choice Mechanisms
articles.title_cn: 学校选择机制中的简单操纵
articles.abstract_en: Market design mechanisms are often required to be strategy proof, ensuring that no misreporting is profitable. This, however, may be overly restrictive: Real-world participants may be unable to engage in complex misreporting. In the context of school choice, this paper proposes that mechanisms ought to be immune only to certain “simple” misreports. While no strategy-proof mechanism Pareto improves on the deferred acceptance (DA) mechanism, we find one under our weaker requirement: Kesten's (2010) efficiency adjusted DA (EADA). By extending our criterion to also prevent simple “collective” misreports, we obtain characterizations of Kesten's mechanism. These insights contribute to practical market design. (JEL C78, D47, D82, I21)
articles.abstract_cn: 市场设计机制通常要求具备策略证明性，确保任何虚假报告都无法获利。然而，这可能过于严格：现实世界中的参与者可能无法进行复杂的虚假报告。在学校选择的背景下，本文提出机制应仅对某些“简单”的虚假报告具有免疫性。虽然没有策略证明机制能在帕累托改进上优于延迟接受（DA）机制，但我们在较弱的条件下找到了一个：Kesten（2010）的效率调整DA（EADA）。通过将我们的标准扩展到同时防止简单的“集体”虚假报告，我们得到了Kesten机制的特征描述。这些见解有助于实际的市场设计。（JEL C78, D47, D82, I21）

articles.title_en: On the Alignment of Consumer Surplus and Total Surplus under Competitive Price Discrimination
articles.title_cn: 论竞争性价格歧视下消费者剩余与总剩余的一致性
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of information in Bertrand competition with differentiated goods and heterogeneous production costs. When producers know their costs and consumers know their values, consumer surplus and total surplus are aligned, in the sense that the information and equilibrium that maximize consumer surplus also maximize total surplus. Alignment may fail if consumers do not know their values: Partial information about values makes purchases less efficient but intensifies price competition. We illustrate this within a Hotelling duopoly framework. (JEL D11, D43, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有差异化产品和异质生产成本的伯特兰竞争中信息的作用。当生产者知道其成本且消费者知道其价值时，消费者剩余和总剩余是一致的，即最大化消费者剩余的信息和均衡也最大化总剩余。如果消费者不知道其价值，这种一致性可能失效：关于价值的部分信息使购买效率降低，但加剧了价格竞争。我们在霍特林双寡头框架内对此进行了说明。（JEL D11, D43, D82, D83）

articles.title_en: Common Ownership and Market Entry: Evidence from the Pharmaceutical Industry
articles.title_cn: 共同所有权与市场进入：来自制药行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: Common ownership—where several firms are (partially) owned by the same investors—and its impact on product market competition has recently drawn much attention. This paper focuses on its implications for market entry. We consider the entry decisions of generic pharmaceutical firms into drug markets that are opened up by the end of regulatory protection and which were previously dominated by a single firm selling the brand name drug. We find robust evidence that an increase in common ownership leads to a significant reduction in generic entry. (JEL D22, G32, L13, L51, L65, M31)
articles.abstract_cn: 共同所有权——即多家公司被同一投资者（部分）持有——及其对产品市场竞争的影响近来引起了广泛关注。本文聚焦于其对市场进入的影响。我们考虑了仿制药公司在监管保护结束而开放、且此前由单一品牌药公司主导的药品市场中的进入决策。我们发现强有力的证据表明，共同所有权的增加导致仿制药进入显著减少。（JEL D22, G32, L13, L51, L65, M31）

articles.abstract_en: Many economic decisions, such as whether to invest in developing new skills, change professions, or purchase a technology, benefit from accurate estimation of skill acquisition. We examine the accuracy of such predictions by having study participants predict the speed at which they will master unfamiliar tasks. Across three studies involving two types of tasks and two levels of difficulty, we find systematic underestimation of learning, even after receiving feedback. In a fourth study, participants predicting others' performance showed significantly less underestimation, suggesting that projection bias—overreliance on immediate perceptions of effort and difficulty—may drive prediction errors. (JEL D83, J24)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多经济决策，例如是否投资于发展新技能、改变职业或购买技术，都受益于对技能获取的准确估计。我们通过让研究参与者预测他们掌握不熟悉任务的速度来检验此类预测的准确性。在涉及两种任务类型和两种难度水平的三项研究中，我们发现即使收到反馈后，学习仍被系统性低估。在第四项研究中，预测他人表现的参与者表现出的低估显著较少，这表明投射偏差——过度依赖对努力和难度的即时感知——可能是预测错误的原因。（JEL D83, J24）

articles.title_en: Dynamic Screening and the Dual Roles of Monitoring
articles.title_cn: 动态筛选与监督的双重角色
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies monitoring in long-term, self-enforcing relationships with adverse selection and moral hazard. Monitoring is used to screen low types by incentivizing them to shirk. Once high types have been identified, monitoring is used both to incentivize effort from high types and to provide off-path (dis)incentives for low types looking to build a reputation. This results in a key trade-off: providing cost-efficient incentives to high types, versus screening low types faster. The optimal contract uses probation after screening: high types are excessively monitored to facilitate better screening. Monitoring declines as the agent's track record improves. (JEL D11, D82, D86)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在存在逆向选择和道德风险的长期自我执行关系中的监督问题。监督被用于通过激励低类型偷懒来筛选低类型。一旦高类型被识别，监督既用于激励高类型努力，也用于为寻求建立声誉的低类型提供路径外的（负）激励。这导致了一个关键的权衡：为高类型提供成本有效的激励，与更快地筛选低类型之间的权衡。最优合同在筛选后使用试用期：高类型被过度监督以促进更好的筛选。随着代理人业绩记录的改善，监督减少。（JEL D11, D82, D86）

articles.title_en: Does Public Competition Crowd Out Private Investment? Evidence from Municipal Provision of Internet Access
articles.title_cn: 公共竞争是否会挤出私人投资？来自市政提供互联网接入的证据
articles.abstract_en: Government infrastructure investment may crowd out investment from private firms or induce them to invest preemptively. The tension between these effects underlies the policy debate over municipal provision of internet access. I estimate demand for broadband and combine these results with a dynamic oligopoly model of private and public firms' entry and investment decisions. I simulate a ban on public entry and find that municipalities crowd out more private fiber-optic investment than they induce through preemption. I estimate that this ban decreases consumer surplus and municipal profits by $27 billion while increasing private profits by $23 billion over ten years. (JEL D22, G31, H44, H57, L33, L96)
articles.abstract_cn: 政府基础设施投资可能会挤出私人企业的投资，或诱导它们进行先发制人的投资。这些效应之间的张力构成了关于市政提供互联网接入的政策辩论的基础。我估计了对宽带的需求，并将这些结果与一个包含私人和公共企业进入及投资决策的动态寡头垄断模型相结合。我模拟了对公共进入的禁令，发现市政当局挤出的私人光纤投资多于其通过先发制人诱导的投资。我估计，这项禁令在十年内使消费者剩余和市政利润减少27亿美元，同时使私人利润增加23亿美元。(JEL D22, G31, H44, H57, L33, L96)
